svg.title: New pages widen the manuscript with dated provenance
svg.desc: Widen the manuscript ribbon with the dated addition while keeping all provenance tabs attached. New evidence enters as a dated change rather than silently rewriting prior scene knowledge.

**Location:** `curt-home-office`

**Frame:** Curt widens the manuscript's page ribbon from [page 105](105.md) by one lane. The provenance tabs stay attached under every thumbnail, and the new pages carry a tab the book has not used before: `DATED ADDITION — 4 SEPTEMBER`.

**Action:** The book gets less complete and one lane wider at the same time.

**Caption:**
> THE BOOK KNOWS LESS THAN IT DID, ABOUT MORE THAN IT DID.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` + `inferred` — creator action; the sentence is the project's standing rule for revision, stated on the page.
